knowledge:
- key_parameters: y=Class labels vector used to generate balanced splits ;; method=In GenerateLearningsets, specifies the split type ("LOOCV", "CV", "MCCV", "bootstrap"); in GeneSelection, specifies the ranking test ("wilcox.test", "t.test", "limma", "rfe", "rf", "lasso", "elasticnet", "boosting") ;; strat=Logical indicating whether to use stratified sampling to preserve class proportions across splits ;; classifier=The classification function to use (e.g., svmCMA, dldaCMA, ldaCMA, scdaCMA, pls_ldaCMA) ;; nbgene=Number of top-ranked genes to retain for classification ;; grids=A named list of hyperparameter values to search during tuning ;; measure=Performance metric to compute ("misclassification", "brier score", "average probability", "sensitivity", "specificity", "AUC")
- alternatives: MLInterfaces=Offers unsupervised learning (clustering, ICA) but lacks standardized, comprehensive hyperparameter tuning and fold-specific variable selection ;; MCRestimate=Supports cross-validation and tuning but lacks S3/S4 class structure and has less comprehensive variable selection
- when_to_use: When performing supervised class prediction on high-dimensional transcriptomics datasets (where the number of features p is much larger than the sample size n) and requiring robust validation, feature selection, and hyperparameter tuning to prevent overfitting.
- pitfalls: Performing variable selection on the entire dataset before splitting into learning sets, which leads to optimistic selection bias and severe overfitting ;; Omitting hyperparameter tuning, which unfairly penalizes complex classifiers (like SVM) and makes simpler classifiers appear artificially superior ;; High computational cost of nested cross-validation during tuning, especially with large grids or many folds

workflows.name: single_classifier_pipeline
workflows.intent: Run a complete classification pipeline for a single classifier including learning set generation, gene selection, hyperparameter tuning, classification, and detailed evaluation.
input: golubX (matrix of gene expression values where rows are samples and columns are genes)
golubY (vector of class labels for the samples)
workflows.stages: 1. Generate learning sets using GenerateLearningsets ;; 2. Perform gene selection using GeneSelection ;; 3. Tune hyperparameters using CMA:::tune ;; 4. Run classification using classification ;; 5. Join results and evaluate performance using join, evaluation, ftable, roc, and obsinfo
workflows.code:
loodat <- GenerateLearningsets(y=golubY, method ="LOOCV")
class(loodat)
getSlots(class(loodat))
show(loodat)

set.seed(321)
fiveCVdat <- GenerateLearningsets(y=golubY, method = "CV", fold = 5, strat = TRUE)

set.seed(456)
MCCVdat <- GenerateLearningsets(y=golubY, method = "MCCV", niter = 3,
                                ntrain = floor(2/3*length(golubY)), strat = TRUE)

set.seed(651)
bootdat <- GenerateLearningsets(y=golubY, method = "bootstrap", niter = 3, strat = TRUE)

varsel_fiveCV <- GeneSelection(X = golubX, y=golubY, learningsets = fiveCVdat, method = "wilcox.test")
varsel_MCCV <- GeneSelection(X = golubX, y=golubY, learningsets = MCCVdat, method = "wilcox.test")
varsel_boot <- GeneSelection(X = golubX, y=golubY, learningsets = bootdat, method = "wilcox.test")

show(varsel_fiveCV)
toplist(varsel_fiveCV, iter=1)
seliter <- numeric()
for(i in 1:5)
seliter <- c(seliter, toplist(varsel_fiveCV, iter = i, top = 10, show = FALSE)$index)
sort(table(seliter), dec = TRUE)

set.seed(351) 
tuningstep <- CMA:::tune(X = golubX, y=golubY, learningsets = fiveCVdat,
                      genesel = varsel_fiveCV, nbgene = 100, classifier = svmCMA,
                      grids = list(cost = c(0.1, 1, 10, 100, 200)),probability=T)

show(tuningstep)
unlist(best(tuningstep))

par(mfrow = c(2,2))
for(i in 1:4)
plot(tuningstep, iter = i, main = paste("iteration", i))

class_fiveCV <- classification(X = golubX, y=golubY, learningsets = fiveCVdat,
                      genesel = varsel_fiveCV, nbgene = 100, classifier = svmCMA,
                      cost = 0.1,probability=T)
                      
class_MCCV <- classification(X = golubX, y=golubY, learningsets = MCCVdat,
                      genesel = varsel_MCCV, nbgene = 100, classifier = svmCMA,
                      cost = 0.1,probability=T)
                      
class_boot <- classification(X = golubX, y=golubY, learningsets = bootdat,
                      genesel = varsel_boot, nbgene = 0.1, classifier = svmCMA,
                      cost = 100,probability=T)

resultlist <- list(class_fiveCV, class_MCCV, class_boot)
result <- lapply(resultlist, join)

schemes <- c("five-fold CV", "MCCV", "bootstrap")

par(mfrow = c(3,1))
for(i in seq(along = result))
 plot(result[[i]], main = schemes[i])

invisible(lapply(result, ftable))

par(mfrow = c(2,2))
for(i in seq(along = result)) roc(result[[i]])

totalresult <- join(result)
ftable(totalresult)

av_MCCV <- evaluation(class_MCCV, measure = "average probability")
show(av_MCCV)
boxplot(av_MCCV)
summary(av_MCCV)

av_obs_MCCV <- evaluation(class_MCCV, measure = "average probability", scheme = "obs")
show(av_obs_MCCV)

obsinfo(av_obs_MCCV, threshold = 0.6)

workflows.name: classifier_comparison
workflows.intent: Compare multiple classification algorithms (specifically discriminant analysis variants) on the same dataset using cross-validation.
input: khanX (matrix of gene expression values where rows are samples and columns are genes)
khanY (vector of class labels for the samples)
workflows.stages: 1. Generate learning sets using GenerateLearningsets ;; 2. Run classification for classifiers that do not require gene selection (e.g., DLDA, PLS-LDA) using classification ;; 3. Perform gene selection using GeneSelection for classifiers that require it (e.g., LDA, FDA, QDA) ;; 4. Run classification for those classifiers using classification with the selected genes ;; 5. Run classification with hyperparameter tuning (e.g., scDA) using classification and tuninglist ;; 6. Compare all classifiers using compare
workflows.code:
set.seed(27611)
fiveCV5iter <- GenerateLearningsets(y=khanY, method = "CV", fold = 5, niter = 5, strat = TRUE)

class_dlda <- classification(X = khanX, y=khanY, learningsets = fiveCV5iter,
                             classifier = dldaCMA)

genesel_da <- GeneSelection(X=khanX, y=khanY, learningsets = fiveCV5iter,
                            method = "t.test", scheme = "one-vs-all")

class_lda <- classification(X = khanX, y=khanY, learningsets = fiveCV5iter,
                             classifier = ldaCMA, genesel= genesel_da,
                             nbgene = 10)
                             
class_fda <- classification(X = khanX, y=khanY, learningsets = fiveCV5iter,
                             classifier = fdaCMA, genesel = genesel_da,
                             nbgene = 10, comp = 2)
                             
class_qda <- classification(X = khanX, y=khanY, learningsets = fiveCV5iter,
                             classifier = qdaCMA, genesel = genesel_da,
                             nbgene = 1)

set.seed(876)
class_scda <- classification(X = khanX, y=khanY, learningsets = fiveCV5iter,
                             classifier = scdaCMA, tuninglist = list(grids = list()))

class_plsda <- classification(X = khanX, y=khanY, learningsets = fiveCV5iter,
                             classifier = pls_ldaCMA)

dalike <- list(class_dlda, class_lda, class_fda, class_qda, class_scda, class_plsda)
par(mfrow = c(3,1))
comparison <- compare(dalike, plot = TRUE, measure = c("misclassification", "brier score", "average probability"))
print(comparison)
